powers: When a character at your location (☐ or any character) discards any number of cards as damage, you may examine the top card of his deck (☐ or his location deck).

For your combat check, you may use your Divine skill + 2d4 (☐ 3d4) and add the Attack, Magic, and Mental traits; a character at your location is dealt 1 Mental damage that may not be reduced. This counts as playing a spell.

roles.name: The Great
powers: When a character at your location (☐ or any character) discards any number of cards as damage, you may examine the top card (☐ or 2 cards) of his deck (☐ or his location deck) (☐ and you may shuffle any non-villain cards you examined into another deck of the same type).

For your combat check, you may use your Divine skill + 2d4 (☐ 3d4) and add the Attack, Magic, and Mental traits; a character at your location is dealt 1 Mental damage that may not be reduced. (☐ You may increase the damage to 2 to additionally ignore a monster’s immunity to the Mental trait on the check.) This counts as playing a spell.

☐ At the start of a character’s turn, if the top card of the blessings discard pile is a blessing, you may exchange it with the top card of the blessings deck. (☐ Then you may shuffle the blessings deck.)
☐ At the end of your turn, you may attempt to recharge a random spell in your discard pile (☐ or from the discard pile of another character at your location to your deck).

roles.name: And Gobbly
powers: When a character at your location (☐ or any character) discards any number of cards as damage, you may examine the top card of his deck (☐ or his location deck). (☐ Then you may shuffle that deck.)

For your combat check, you may use your Divine skill + 2d4 (☐ 3d4) (☐ 4d4) and add the Attack, Magic, and Mental traits; a character at your location is dealt 1 Mental damage that may not be reduced. This counts as playing a spell.
☐ Any character at your location may banish (☐ or bury) an ally from his discard pile to evade his encounter.
☐ Instead of the first exploration of your turn, if your location deck contains only 1 card (☐ or 2 cards), you may attempt to close your location.
